reason_for_human: Eleven of the twelve occurrences are רוּחַ/רוּחָא 'spirit/wind/breath' — consistently glossed as בחינת רוח (of the tzaddik, lungs, nose/breath, charity, nigunah, etc.), all the same word with normal inflection, so kept together. The lone outlier is occ 2683 in LM 23, where the proof explicitly reads רֶוַח 'profit' ('גַּד the mule gave birth = the aspect of profit... they seem to be profiting but aren't') — a true homograph of a different word (revach = monetary gain), so I split it off.
